products.name: Adobe Analytics

what.text: Adobe's web and app analytics product: it collects data from digital customer interactions into report suites and reports on it in Analysis Workspace.
what.quote: Adobe Analytics enables organizations to gather data and gain actionable insights from any digital customer interaction.

status_source.quote: Customer Journey Analytics is Adobe’s next-generation Analytics solution that lets you use the power of Analysis Workspace with data from Adobe Experience Platform.

bv.how: Brand Visibility connects to an Adobe Analytics report suite (paid offer only, same IMS organization, the user's own Adobe sign-in) and pulls aggregated referral, engagement and commerce metrics for AI-referred visits into the Referral Traffic dashboard's Business Impact tab. Adobe Analytics is one of three analytics providers in Brands Management (with Google Analytics 4 and Customer Journey Analytics).
bv.quote: The Adobe Analytics integration connects Adobe Brand Visibility with your organization’s Adobe Analytics data so you can measure how AI-driven discovery translates into real website engagement and business outcomes.

connections.how: Analytics for Target (A4T): Target activities use Analytics conversion metrics and segments, and Analytics becomes the reporting source for the activity.
connections.quote: Adobe Analytics for Target (A4T) is a cross-solution integration that lets you create activities based on Analytics conversion metrics and audience segments.

connections.how: The Analytics source connector streams report suite data into an Experience Platform dataset, where it can enrich Real-Time Customer Profile.
connections.quote: Adobe Experience Platform allows you to ingest Adobe Analytics data through the Analytics source connector.

connections.how: The Experience Cloud Audiences destination sends Real-Time CDP audiences to Adobe Analytics; Adobe says this direction needs an Audience Manager license.
connections.quote: Use this destination to activate audiences from Real-Time CDP to Audience Manager and Adobe Analytics. To send audiences to Adobe Analytics, you need an Audience Manager license.

connections.how: Report suite data reaches Customer Journey Analytics through the Analytics source connector in Experience Platform, then a CJA connection and data view.
connections.quote: This quick start guide explains how you can use the data collected by Adobe Analytics in Customer Journey Analytics.

connections.how: AEM as a Cloud Service gets an Analytics configuration (IMS authentication) and the Adobe Analytics extension is set up in tags (Launch) to track page activity.
connections.quote: Integrating Adobe Analytics and AEM as a Cloud Service lets you track your web page activity.

connections.how: Assets Insights: AEM Assets pulls image impressions and clicks from an Analytics report suite with AEM Assets Reporting enabled (Analytics 2.0 API, OAuth server-to-server). An Analytics license is required.
connections.quote: Experience Manager Assets fetches usage data about digital assets deployed on third-party websites directly from Adobe Analytics.

connections.how: The aem.live martech integration sets up Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Target or Journey Optimizer, the Adobe Client Data Layer and tags on an Edge Delivery site.
connections.quote: The stack combines Adobe Experience Platform WebSDK, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target or Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Client Data Layer and Adobe Experience Platform Tags.

connections.how: Commerce event data sent through the Data Connection (Experience Platform connector) extension and a datastream reaches an Analytics report suite. Adobe's tutorial walks through the setup, and the Data Connection overview names Adobe Analytics as a downstream product.
connections.quote: Create a new report suite in Adobe Analytics, or identify the ID of the report suite that you will be pushing Commerce data into.

connections.how: Web behavioral events captured by Adobe Analytics and streamed into Experience Platform through the Analytics source connector can trigger journeys (rule-based events; Adobe Customer Care enables the Analytics data source).
connections.quote: You can leverage all of the web behavioral event data which you are already capturing through Adobe Analytics or Web SDK, and streaming into Adobe Experience Platform, in order to trigger journeys and automate experiences for your customers.

connections.how: Marketo Web Personalization (RTP) adds organization, industry and RTP campaign data to Adobe Analytics reports.
connections.quote: Analyze your web analytics from a B2B perspective by viewing organization, industry and Marketo Real-Time Personalization (RTP) campaign data within your Adobe Analytics account.

connections.how: Marketo static lists sent to Experience Cloud can be shared to Analytics report suites, only for customers who also own Audience Manager.
connections.quote: For users that own both Adobe Audience Manager and Adobe Analytics, this integration will enable audiences to be shared from Marketo to your Adobe Analytics Report Suites

connections.how: Coworker Chat queries Adobe Analytics report suites in natural language, with the user's Analytics permissions; Adobe Analytics is on the list of applications where Coworker Chat is available now.
connections.quote: Coworker Chat accesses data from your Customer Journey Analytics data views or Adobe Analytics report suites, allowing you to explore data and get answers with natural-language prompts.

connections.how: The Brand Concierge web client's event callback lets the page forward conversation engagement events to Adobe Analytics. The FAQ adds one line: 'You can also integrate with Adobe Analytics for deeper analysis.' No setup guide beyond the callback was found.
connections.quote: The event callback system lets a page observe Web Client lifecycle events, user interactions, responses, feedback, and errors in real time, useful for sending engagement data to Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, or other third-party systems.

connections.how: Audience Analytics: Audience Manager segments are shared to Analytics in real time; Analytics hits are forwarded server-side to Audience Manager.
connections.quote: Segments are shared from Adobe Audience Manager to Analytics in real time, to inform audience discovery, segmentation, and optimization.

connections.how: The Adobe Analytics connector (Web Analytics connectors add-on) sends email campaign indicators and attributes from Campaign v8 to Analytics.
connections.quote: This integration sends indicators and attributes of email campaigns delivered by Adobe Campaign to Adobe Analytics.

connections.how: Experience Cloud Triggers: behaviors detected in Analytics (for example cart abandonment) reach Campaign through the pipeline and trigger near real time emails.
connections.quote: You can use Experience Cloud Triggers to connect data between Adobe Campaign and Adobe Analytics using the pipeline.

connections.how: Analytics for Advertising: click-through and view-through ad interactions are tracked in Analytics, and Analytics segments and events go to Adobe Advertising for remarketing and bid optimization.
connections.quote: Analytics for Advertising integrates Adobe Analytics and Adobe Advertising to extend and enhance the capabilities of each product.

connections.how: B2B Customer Attributes: Marketo Measure uploads account and attributed revenue attributes to an Experience Cloud Customer Attributes source that Analytics subscribes to.
connections.quote: The B2B Customer Attributes integration enables mutual users of Marketo Measure and Adobe Analytics to enrich their Adobe Analytics user profiles with valuable metadata derived from the Marketo Measure attribution engine

connections.how: Adobe Analytics can be the reporting source for the experiments the accelerator lists; the primary metric is imported from it.
connections.quote: Changing the primary metric applies to teams that use Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Analytics as the reporting source for experiments created in Adobe Target or Adobe Journey Optimizer

connections.how: Event data brought into Experience Platform with the Analytics source connector can be used as model input.
connections.quote: Data collected using the Adobe Analytics source connector. And transformed into datasets conforming to the default or a custom version of the Adobe Analytics schema.

The Customer Journey Analytics integration uses the Referring Domain dimension instead. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics/components/dimensions/referrer-type

Security detail on the Brand Visibility page that an RFI answer may need: the ingested Analytics data is 'encrypted in transit not at rest' today. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/brand-visibility/using/resources/adobe-analytics-integration

Analytics 1.4 APIs reached end of life on August 31, 2026 (Adobe's discontinued products list); AEM Assets Insights and the Campaign Analytics connector both had to move to the 2.0 API. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/discontinued/using/overview

Adobe positions Customer Journey Analytics as the next-generation product; no end date for Adobe Analytics was found on Experience League or helpx. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics/analyze/admin-overview/analytics-overview
The Analytics integration guide also has pages for Campaign Standard reporting, Campaign Classic and AEM Assets reporting. https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics/integration/home

products.name: Adobe Audience Manager

what.text: Adobe's data management platform (DMP): it collects audience data, builds traits and segments, and sends those segments to ad servers, DSPs and other Adobe products.
what.quote: Audience Manager helps you bring your audience data assets together, making it easy to collect commercially relevant information about site visitors, create marketable segments, and serve targeted advertising and content to the right audience.

products.status_note: No end date found on Experience League or helpx. Adobe says there are no plans to modify the DMP, warns that third-party cookie loss will limit its scale, and publishes an evolution guide from Audience Manager to Real-Time CDP. The quoted sentence sits on Adobe's Device Co-op end-of-life FAQ (page updated May 29 2026, text written when Device Co-op was retired). Adobe support also has a public article on decommissioning Audience Manager for a customer whose contract ends.

status_source.quote: There are no plans to modify the current Audience Manager Data Management Platform (DMP). However, the deprecation of third-party cookies will likely create scale challenges for most DMP users.

connections.how: The Audience Manager source streams first-party Audience Manager data (real-time and profile data, traits and segments) into Experience Platform.
connections.quote: The Adobe Audience Manager source streams first-party data collected in Adobe Audience Manager for activation in Adobe Experience Platform.

connections.how: Two-way audience sharing: the Audience Manager source connector brings traits and segments in, and the Experience Cloud Audiences destination sends Real-Time CDP audiences to Audience Manager (Real-Time CDP Prime and Ultimate).
connections.quote: The audience sharing functionality between Audience Manager and Adobe Experience Platform allows you to share your Audience Manager traits and segments to Adobe Experience Platform and Experience Platform segments to Audience Manager.

connections.how: All Audience Manager segments appear in Target's audience list through the Experience Cloud ID service and Profiles and Audiences (Shared Audiences).
connections.quote: This integration lets you send Audience Manager segments to Adobe Target.

connections.how: Audience Analytics: Audience Manager segments are shared to Analytics in real time, and Analytics hits are forwarded server-side to Audience Manager.
connections.quote: Segments are shared from Adobe Audience Manager to Analytics in real time, to inform audience discovery, segmentation, and optimization.

connections.how: Campaign imports shared audiences as lists and exports lists as Experience Cloud shared audiences. The page sits in the Campaign Classic v7 guide with an 'Also applies to v8' badge; Adobe provisions the integration.
connections.quote: Integrate Adobe Campaign with Experience Cloud Audiences or Adobe Audience Manager

connections.how: Advertising DSP and Search, Social, & Commerce import Audience Manager segments for ad targeting; DSP can send media exposure data back to Audience Manager.
connections.quote: Search, Social, & Commerce and DSP can pull in metadata, hierarchy data, and unique audience data for all of an advertiser’s or agency’s Audience Manager and other Adobe audiences.

connections.how: Marketo static lists sent to Experience Cloud are written to Audience Manager as traits and a segment; Marketo can also sync an audience from Experience Cloud.
connections.quote: Marketo will also create a segment in your Audience Manager Instance using the ECID trait as the sole segmentation criterion.

connections.how: Collaboration connects to an Audience Manager instance in the same IMS organization and sources eligible first-party segments on a schedule for overlap analysis and activation.
connections.quote: After you create the connection, Collaboration retrieves audience membership from Adobe Audience Manager on a recurring schedule and makes those audiences available for overlap analysis and activation within your collaboration projects.

products.name: Adobe Campaign (current version: Campaign v8; older versions: Campaign Classic v7 and Campaign Standard)

what.text: Adobe's cross-channel campaign management product for email, mobile, direct mail and other channels, run on its own customer database and workflows.
what.quote: Adobe Campaign is the Adobe CX Enterprise solution for cross-channel campaign management.

products.status_note: Campaign v8 (Managed Cloud Services, client console plus Web user interface) is the current version and the one researched here. Campaign Classic v7: Adobe says it will reach End of Support in the coming years, and Adobe's support periods table lists end of core support as 12/31/2030. Campaign Standard: no end date found; Adobe says Standard users are now eligible to transition to Campaign v8.

status_source.quote: Campaign v8 is Adobe’s strategic platform, ideal for organizations needing high-volume campaigns, modern web UI, cloud-native benefits, and long-term support. Campaign Classic v7 will reach End of Support in the coming years.

connections.how: The Adobe Analytics connector (Web Analytics connectors add-on) sends email campaign indicators and attributes from Campaign v8 to Analytics. Not compatible with transactional messaging.
connections.quote: This integration sends indicators and attributes of email campaigns delivered by Adobe Campaign to Adobe Analytics.

connections.how: Experience Cloud Triggers: behaviors detected in Analytics reach Campaign through the pipeline and trigger near real time emails. Adobe implements it for Managed Cloud Services customers.
connections.quote: You can use Experience Cloud Triggers to connect data between Adobe Campaign and Adobe Analytics using the pipeline.

connections.how: Email content and templates are authored as pages in Experience Manager (Sites, Adobe Campaign Email template) and used in Campaign deliveries; the Campaign Web interface connects to AEM as a Cloud Service through an external account.
connections.quote: Integration between Adobe Campaign and Adobe Experience Manager allows you to manage the content of your email deliveries as well as your forms directly in Adobe Experience Manager.

connections.how: The Campaign Web email designer has an asset picker on an AEM Assets as a Cloud Service repository; assets are uploaded, managed and dropped into email content from Campaign.
connections.quote: If needed, click Manage assets to directly access your Adobe Experience Manager Assets workspace.

connections.how: The Adobe Campaign Managed Cloud Services destination sends Experience Platform audiences and profile attributes to Campaign v8, and the source connector returns delivery and tracking logs.
connections.quote: The Adobe Campaign Managed Cloud Service Destination and Source connectors allow seamless integration between Adobe Campaign and Adobe Experience Platform.

connections.how: Journeys built in Journey Optimizer send email, push and SMS through Campaign v8 transactional messaging (a Campaign action in the journey).
connections.quote: Integration between Adobe Campaign and Adobe Journey Optimizer allows you orchestrate customer journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer and send emails, push notifications and/or SMS using Adobe Campaign Transactional Messaging capabilities.

connections.how: A Campaign email carries a Target offer: when the recipient opens the email, Target serves a dynamic image chosen by its rules. Static images only.
connections.quote: Connect Campaign and Target to include an offer from Adobe Target in an Adobe Campaign email delivery.

connections.how: Workfront Fusion has Adobe Campaign v7/v8 modules that start scenarios on Campaign events and create, read or update Campaign records. Needs Workfront Fusion.
connections.quote: With the Adobe Campaign modules, you can start an Adobe Workfront Fusion scenario based on events in your Adobe Campaign v7/v8 account, create, read, or update records, search for records using criteria you set, and perform custom API calls.

connections.how: Campaign imports shared audiences as lists and exports lists as Experience Cloud shared audiences (Audience Manager or Experience Cloud Audiences). The page is in the Campaign Classic v7 guide with an 'Also applies to v8' badge.
connections.quote: Integrate Adobe Campaign with Experience Cloud Audiences or Adobe Audience Manager

connections.how: The Coworker Chat workflows page has a Campaign v8 section: Coworker Chat finds and updates deliveries, manages assets, explores the data model and troubleshoots workflows in Campaign v8, and can save approved content back to Campaign v8.
connections.quote: Use Coworker Chat to find and update deliveries, manage assets, explore the data model, and inspect, validate, and troubleshoot workflows in Adobe Campaign v8.

connections.how: Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce builds a Google Ads customer match audience from a Campaign email list, through an SFTP external account and a workflow that the Adobe account team supplies.
connections.quote: You can create a Google Ads customer match audience from an email list within Adobe Campaign by setting up an account link and a workflow in Campaign.

connections.how: GenStudio for Performance Marketing email experiences can be used in Campaign v8 Web (email channel only).
connections.quote: To enhance marketing efficiciency and to maintain brand consistency, you can seamlessly integrate GenStudio for Performance Marketing experiences with Adobe Campaign

products.name: Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible)

what.text: A B2B marketing attribution product: it tracks web sessions and ad spend, ties touchpoints to CRM leads and opportunities, and reports which channels drive revenue.
what.quote: Marketo Measure is a marketing attribution solution that automatically tracks and reports on channel performance, providing visibility into which channels drive the most customer engagement and allowing you to optimize your marketing spend accordingly.

products.status_note: Renamed from Bizible (on Adobe's rebranded products list). No end-of-life notice found on Experience League or helpx. Worth knowing: the page titled 'Current Release Notes' covers 2024 releases only, and there are two editions (Tiers 1 to 3, and Ultimate, which takes its B2B data through Experience Platform).

status_source.quote: Learn how to get the most out of Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly, Bizible).

connections.how: Marketo Measure (Tiers 1 to 3) connects to a Marketo Engage instance over its REST API and builds attribution touchpoints from Marketo program memberships, activities and people.

connections.how: Marketo Measure Ultimate receives its B2B data (accounts, opportunities, contacts, leads, campaigns) from Experience Platform through the Marketo Measure Ultimate destination; Adobe describes it as an integration with Real-Time CDP B2B or B2P Edition.
connections.quote: Use the Marketo Measure destination to export business-to-business (B2B) data from Adobe Experience Platform to Marketo Measure. The destination card is only available to Marketo Measure Ultimate customers.

connections.how: B2B Customer Attributes: Marketo Measure uploads account names, attributed revenue and funnel stage to an Experience Cloud Customer Attributes source that Adobe Analytics subscribes to. Free for customers with both products.
connections.quote: The B2B Customer Attributes integration enables mutual users of Marketo Measure and Adobe Analytics to enrich their Adobe Analytics user profiles with valuable metadata derived from the Marketo Measure attribution engine

connections.how: The same Customer Attributes source can be subscribed to by Adobe Target, so the Marketo Measure attributes become available there.
connections.quote: The attributes surfaced via this integration count against your contractual attribute limits in Adobe Analytics and Adobe Target.

products.name: Adobe Advertising (Advertising DSP; Advertising Search, Social, & Commerce; Advertising Creative)

what.text: Adobe's ad buying suite: a demand-side platform for display and video ads, a search, social and commerce ad manager, and a creative tool for ad experiences.
what.quote: Learn how to manage, optimize, and report on display ad campaigns using Advertising DSP.

status_source.quote: Through Adobe DSP’s integration with OpenAI Ads, you can now run ChatGPT Ads chat card ads, which appear inside ChatGPT conversations.

connections.how: Analytics for Advertising: click-through and view-through ad interactions are tracked in Analytics, and Analytics segments and conversion events go to Adobe Advertising for remarketing and bid optimization.
connections.quote: Analytics for Advertising integrates Adobe Analytics and Adobe Advertising to extend and enhance the capabilities of each product.

connections.how: DSP and Search, Social, & Commerce import Audience Manager segments for ad targeting; DSP can send media exposure data to Audience Manager.
connections.quote: Search, Social, & Commerce and DSP can pull in metadata, hierarchy data, and unique audience data for all of an advertiser’s or agency’s Audience Manager and other Adobe audiences.

connections.how: Two-way data sharing: Advertising campaign performance appears in Customer Journey Analytics and attribution data returns to Advertising, either on top of Analytics for Advertising or natively through the Web SDK.
connections.quote: Adobe Advertising is integrated with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics for bi-directional data sharing and reporting.

connections.how: Ad click and exposure signals are shared with Target to run A/B tests that match on-site experiences to DSP or search ads; results are read in Analytics for Target.
connections.quote: Adobe Advertising and Adobe Target make it even easier for marketers to deliver a personalized and connected experience across paid media and on-site messaging.

connections.how: The Adobe Advertising DSP destination sends Real-Time CDP audiences (hashed emails, ECIDs and cookies, mobile ad IDs) to a DSP account, where they become universal IDs for targeting.
connections.quote: The Adobe Advertising Demand-Side Platform (DSP) destination allows users to share both authenticated and unauthenticated first-party audiences with a DSP account or specific advertiser within an account.

connections.how: Marketo static lists sent to Experience Cloud can be used in Adobe Advertising (the Marketo pages still say Adobe Advertising Cloud).
connections.quote: This integration includes: Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Audience Manager and Adobe Advertising Cloud.

connections.how: Advertising Creative can add images from an Experience Manager asset library to its Creative Libraries once the DSP account holds the Experience Manager organization ID (Adobe's account team sets it).
connections.quote: Before you can upload your existing Experience Manager image assets to your Creative Libraries, the advertiser account settings for your associated DSP account must specify the organization ID for the Experience Manager account.

connections.how: Search, Social, & Commerce builds a Google Ads customer match audience from a Campaign email list, through an SFTP external account and a Campaign workflow that the Adobe account team supplies.
connections.quote: You can create a Google Ads customer match audience from an email list within Adobe Campaign by setting up an account link and a workflow in Campaign.

connections.how: Advertising Creative imports display ad experiences from GenStudio for Performance Marketing into its creative libraries.
connections.quote: Advertisers with Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing can now import display ad experiences from GenStudio to your creative libraries.
